payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details on how non-standard pronunciation is identified through annotations in transcriptions of conversations, including various types of disfluencies and mispronunciations.

claims.text: Non-standard pronunciation is identified through annotations in transcriptions that include mispronunciations, poor intelligibility, and undefined sounds.
Annotations for non-standard pronunciations also include labels for foreign words and other disfluencies such as hesitations and false starts.
The resource includes non-standardized orthographic transcriptions that aid in studying language change and normalization.
